[ THE PROBLEM ]

EXAM INTEGRITY DEMANDS ACCURACY.

Standard exam generation tools either rely blindly on generative AI—hallucinating syllabus questions or producing unbalanced marks distributions—or lack verifiable constraint checking.

QPGen enforces an uncompromising principle: the blueprint is the source of constraints, the question bank is the source of verified questions, and the backend engine is the source of truth. AI is an assistant, never the authority.

[ HOW IT WORKS ]

BLUEPRINT TO IMMUTABLE PAPER.

01 / BLUEPRINT

SPECIFY CONSTRAINTS

Define university syllabus quotas across Units, Bloom's Taxonomy Levels (BTL), Course Outcomes (CO), difficulty, and subdivision marks.

02 / VALIDATE

SERVER VALIDATION

A pure, I/O-free validation engine strictly recalculates every marginal distribution and subquestion split before database commitment.

03 / SOLVE

BACKTRACKING SELECTION

A multi-dimensional constraint solver evaluates slot assignments and backtracks when branches dead-end to guarantee a mathematically sound paper.

04 / SNAPSHOT

IMMUTABLE FINALIZE

Selected questions, allotted marks, and rubrics are frozen in an immutable audit snapshot ready for PDF and print rendering.

[ SYSTEM ]

WHAT IS USED.

BACKEND

NODE.JS + TYPESCRIPT

Express REST API, deterministic validation engine, and recursive backtracking constraint solver.

DATABASE

PRISMA + POSTGRESQL

Strict relation-level authorization, append-only audit logging, and immutable paper snapshotting.

FRONTEND

REACT + VITE + TAILWIND

Multi-step blueprint wizard, dynamic parts builder, and real-time live preview with blank rendering.

[ KEY FEATURES ]

ENGINEERING DETAILS.

01

TWO-ENGINE ARCHITECTURE

Separation of pure validation (arithmetic & constraint sanity) from recursive constraint satisfaction selection.

02

PER-QUESTION SUBDIVISIONS

Dynamic question structures supporting complex multi-part configurations (e.g. 15 subdivisions across 7 questions with custom mark allocation).

03

BULK DOCUMENT INGESTION

PDF/DOCX question extraction with automated unit mapping via CO order and near-duplicate detection.

04

ZERO-TRUST SECURITY

Argon2id hashing, secure httpOnly JWT cookies, progressive lockout, and server-enforced IDOR protection.
